title: Mapping the MBE Manuscript to the Package
text: Multi-Component Bayesian Endpoint (MBE) workflow described Lee et al. (2026) two stages: Fit trial-level Bayesian meta-analytic model historical randomized clinical trials. Use draws historical model update treatment effects new trial. package implementation deliberately restricted one clinical endpoint exactly two surrogate endpoints. chronic kidney disease example, two surrogates treatment effects chronic acute eGFR slopes.

title: Mapping the MBE Manuscript to the Package
text: historical_model_fit_2surrogates() expects one row per historical trial following nine columns: trial_sim_dat provides shareable simulated example 66 trials. restricted CKD-EPI CT trial data used motivating analysis distributed package.

text: historical model assessed holding 66 trials turn. fit_loo_historical_models() fits random-intercept, inverse-gamma model 65 trials saves posterior columns required assessment. batch restartable: existing trial files reused unless overwrite = TRUE. loo_cv_model_assessment() calculates two quantities: LOO-CV RMSE compares held-clinical estimate posterior mean full-carryover MBE update. Tolerance coverage predicts held-observed clinical estimate conditioning two observed surrogate estimates. posterior draw bb, predictive clinical estimate distribution N(β0(b)+β1(b)γ01(b)+β2(b)γ02(b),λθ2(b)+σθ̂02). N\left(   \beta_0^{(b)} + \beta_1^{(b)}\gamma_{01}^{(b)} +   \beta_2^{(b)}\gamma_{02}^{(b)},   \lambda_{\theta}^{2(b)} + \sigma^2_{\hat{\theta}_0} \right). variance therefore includes historical model’s residual clinical heterogeneity held-trial’s clinical sampling variance. completed, converged 66-trial assessment included two compact package datasets users need rerun 66 Stan models: small derived tables installed MBE. complete leave-one-posterior files remain data-raw/ suitable external archival storage.
code: loo_paths <- fit_loo_historical_models(   data = trial_sim_dat,   output_dir = "data-raw/loo-random-inverse-gamma",   seed = 2026,   nchains = 4,   ncores = 4,   niter = 2000,   nwarmup = 1000,   adapt_delta = 0.95,   max_treedepth = 15 ) loo_assessment <- loo_cv_model_assessment(   loo_posteriors = "data-raw/loo-random-inverse-gamma",   data = trial_sim_dat,   seed = 2026 ) data("loo_assessment_summary", package = "MBE") data("loo_assessment_by_trial", package = "MBE")  knitr::kable(loo_assessment_summary, digits = 4) coverage_counts <- data.frame(   interval = c("95%", "90%"),   covered = c(     sum(loo_assessment_by_trial$covered_95),     sum(loo_assessment_by_trial$covered_90)   ),   total = nrow(loo_assessment_by_trial) ) knitr::kable(coverage_counts)

title: Multi-Component Bayesian Endpoints with Two Surrogates
text: repository contains R package accompanying Multi-Component Bayesian Endpoints Randomized Clinical Trials manuscript Lee et al. (2026). package implements MBE exactly one clinical endpoint two surrogate endpoints. current CKD implementation uses chronic acute eGFR slopes two surrogates. Bayesian framework incorporates historical randomized clinical trials (RCTs) propagates uncertainty estimating treatment effect clinical endpoint surrogate effects. See Mapping MBE Manuscript Package complete workflow.

code: # Use the example data provided in the package. # Load the historical posterior samples where the model was fit # with random intercept and inverse gamma prior for variance parameters # on the 65/66 simulated trials in `trial_sim_dat` dataset. # It's the first trial that was left out as if it was a new trial. # We demonstrate estimating the posterior distribution of MBE on this first # row that was left out. data("historical_posterior") data("trial_sim_dat") one_sim_dat<-list(  # treatment effect on CE ClnEst=trial_sim_dat$CE_est[1], ClnSE=trial_sim_dat$CE_se[1],  # treatment effect on chronic slope Sur1Est=trial_sim_dat$Sur1_est[1], Sur1SE=trial_sim_dat$Sur1_se[1],  # treatment effect on acute slope Sur2Est=trial_sim_dat$Sur2_est[1], Sur2SE=trial_sim_dat$Sur2_se[1],  # correlation between CE and chronic slope R1Clin=trial_sim_dat$Cor_CE_Sur1[1],  # correlation between CE and acute slope R2Clin=trial_sim_dat$Cor_CE_Sur2[1],  # correlation between chronic slope and acute slope R12=trial_sim_dat$Cor_Sur1_Sur2[1] )  MBE_distribution<-MBE( mcmc_dat = historical_posterior, sample_dat=one_sim_dat, diffuse_se = 100, diffuse = TRUE, intercept0 = TRUE )  head(MBE_distribution$post_psi0) #>         clinical surrogate1 surrogate2 #> [1,] -0.01742418  0.4358344  -7.647448 #> [2,] -0.05070114  0.3625249  -5.290546 #> [3,] -0.21549799  0.9284195  -4.653444 #> [4,] -0.22270912  1.0586468  -4.846612 #> [5,] -0.02885444  0.6432777  -8.217527 #> [6,] -0.22661395  0.9851503  -4.977536

title: Fit the Historical Model for Exactly Two Surrogate Endpoints — historical_model_fit_2surrogates
text: data data frame matrix one row per trial exactly nine numeric columns (order matter): CE_est, CE_se, Sur1_est, Sur1_se, Sur2_est, Sur2_se, Cor_CE_Sur1, Cor_CE_Sur2, Cor_Sur1_Sur2. Data third surrogate endpoint accepted. random_intercept logical indicating whether include intercept regression modeling. prior_for_uncertainty character indicating prior distribution uncertainty parameters. Options "half_normal" half-normal prior standard deviation scale "inverse_gamma" inverse-gamma prior variance scale. Default "half_normal". output_dir Character string. folder path CmdStan save raw MCMC chain CSV files. Defaults tempdir(), saves files temporary session folder automatically deleted R closes. keep CSV files permanently, provide local directory path (e.g., "./" current working directory, "./mcmc_output"). show_messages Logical; whether print progress console. Default TRUE. nchains number chains MCMC sampling. Default 4. ncores number chains run parallel. Default 1 (sequential processing). set value greater 1, function use parallel processing run multiple chains simultaneously. niter number post-warmup samples save chain. Default 2000. nwarmup number warmup iterations MCMC sampling. ... Additional arguments forwarded cmdstanr's $sample() method (e.g., adapt_delta, max_treedepth, seed, refresh). cmdstanr's default values used adapt_delta = 0.9 max_treedepth = 12. addition, chains, parallel_chains, iter_sampling, iter_warmup set values nchains, ncores, niter, nwarmup, respectively, unless overridden ....

title: Fit the Historical Model for Exactly Two Surrogate Endpoints — historical_model_fit_2surrogates
text: function fits trial-level meta-analysis model using 2-stage random effects Bayesian model chronic kidney disease (CKD) context first introduced Lee et al. (2026). true treatment effect clinical endpoint \(\theta_i\), true treatment effect two surrogate endpoints \(\gamma_{, 1}\) \(\gamma_{, 2}\) \(\)-th trial, model specified follows: $$\hat{\psi}_i \mid \psi_i \sim N_3(\psi_i, \Sigma_{y, })$$ \(\psi_i = (\theta_i, \gamma_{, 1}, \gamma_{, 2})^T\) true treatment effect vector \(\)-th trial, \(\hat{\psi}_i\) observed (estimated) treatment effect vector \(\)-th trial, \(\Sigma_{y, }\) covariance matrix corresponding \(\hat{\psi}_i\). density \(\psi\) can expressed sequence conditional densities: $$\gamma_{, 2} \sim N(\mu_2, \sigma_2^2)$$ $$\gamma_{, 1} \mid \gamma_{, 2} \sim N(\alpha_{\gamma_1} + \beta_{\gamma_1} \cdot \gamma_{, 2}, \lambda^2_{\gamma_1})$$ $$\theta_i \mid \gamma_{, 1}, \gamma_{, 2} \sim N(\alpha_\theta + \beta_{\gamma_1} \cdot \gamma_{, 1} + \beta_{\gamma_2} \cdot \gamma_{, 2}, \lambda^2_\theta)$$ function fits model using MCMC sampling historical RCTs returns posterior distribution model parameters. loo waic components use Stan log_lik values conditional trial's latent treatment-effect vector. therefore describe conditional model fit. prediction completely held-trial, use fit_loo_historical_models() loo_cv_model_assessment(), refit model removing trial.

what: Simulated Data for Interim Analysis — interim_sim_dat
title: Simulated Data for Interim Analysis — interim_sim_dat
text: simulated data set chronic kidney disease clinical trials. definitive clinical endpoint first ESRD 57% decline baseline eGFR. addition treatment effect estimated definitive clinical endpoint, treatment effect estimated exactly two surrogate endpoints: chronic eGFR slope (Sur1) acute eGFR slope (Sur2). data contain eight scenarios. Cases 1 2 use baseline eGFR range 30–60, cases 3 4 use 30–75, cases 5–8 use 25–50 ml/min/1.73m2. Odd-numbered cases slope treatment effect; even-numbered cases active slope treatment effect 0.8. Cases 7 8 repeat settings cases 5 6, respectively.
